executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Casas del XVI appeared in at least one AI answer for 41.3% of the traveler needs we tested, and across every individual AI answer it appeared 31.7% of the time. Together, these results show how broadly AI recognizes the hotel and how consistently a traveler would encounter it.

The clearest strength in this period is often placed near the top when ai ranks hotels. See the summary at left for the supporting numbers. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Casas del XVI appeared in the Top 3 80% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

AI currently reflects 40% of the monitored facts and attributes that define the hotel, so important parts of the property proposition are not consistently represented in AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

sections.headline: Casas del XVI's most important issue is concentrated competitive displacement by JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo, not a vague visibility problem.
sections.keyInsight: JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo appears in 37 monitored scenarios where Casas del XVI is absent. That concentration matters more than a long competitor list because it identifies a repeatable substitution pattern. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Soft Brand / Independence at 0% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers.
sections.whyItMatters: Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of Casas del XVI in recurring demand contexts. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the concentrated leak. A displacement pattern that repeats is more actionable than a soft overall visibility narrative.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on the demand contexts where JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo is consistently surfaced instead of Casas del XVI. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, and whether the hotel's own proposition is complete for those same contexts.
sections.whatToReview: Open the underlying displacement evidence for JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo and compare attributes cited in those answers with Casas del XVI's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present.
